FILE: app/notes/arrow-keys.json
```json
{ "rotateFraction": 0.71, "altFraction": 0.71, "ctrlSameDistance": true }
```

I wrote the JSON with the normalized two-key fraction (1/√2 → 0.71) for both plain and Alt cases, and true for Ctrl because the normalized pan vector keeps the total target movement distance the same. I was slightly unsure whether Alt+Right alone still rotates alpha or is ignored, but the notes only single out Alt+Up as special, so I treated Alt+Right as still rotating.
